body:
Thanks for the report. It came through without a description, so I can't see what went wrong. What did you do, and what did you see?

From the attached facts: the Muse Code CLI is installed (1.4.2) but not signed in, and no Model API key is stored, so the extension has nothing to connect to yet. On the panel's landing screen, sign in one of two ways:

- **Sign In With Your Meta Account**: shows an approval code in the panel; approve it in your browser.
- **Use a Model API Key**: paste a key from dev.meta.ai (pay as you go).

0.18.0 is also out (you are on 0.16.0) with several sign-in and Windows fixes, so please update first.

If it still fails after updating and signing in, reply here with the message the panel shows and I'll dig in. The next release also makes this report form ask what happened and record which screen you were on, so a report like this one will carry what we need.
